source: Ah, you’re up, Yoshinori.
translation: 啊，你醒了，Yoshinori。

source: Well, we figured we’d give our new inspector a better impression today.
translation: 好了，我们想让新来的检查员今天留下更好的印象。

source: Sounds complicated. Shouldn’t you get some rest?
translation: 听起来挺复杂的。你不该休息一下吗？

source: I’m actually already done for the day, sir! Now I can hang out with you guys before I go to bed!
translation: 其实我今天的工作已经做完了，先生！现在睡觉前我可以和你们一起待一会儿！

source: Yeaaahh! Come relax with us and have some breakfast. It’s still hella early anyways!
translation: 好耶！来和我们放松一下，吃点早餐吧。反正现在还早得很！

source: He did mine a while ago and it was pretty spot-on about my past. I was really surprised and kinda spooked at the same time!
translation: 他刚才帮我算过，对我的过去说得非常准。我既惊讶又有点害怕！

source: Slowly but surely, I’m starting to think Lloyd here is some kind of a leprechaun or something.
translation: 我开始慢慢觉得，这里的Lloyd可能是某种妖精之类的。

source: I’ve read a few books about tarot in the past as well, but it seems to have surged in popularity recently.
translation: 我以前也读过几本关于塔罗牌的书，不过最近它似乎突然变得流行起来。

source: Yeah! People all over the internet love to get into discussions about the meanings!
translation: 是啊！互联网上到处都是喜欢讨论牌义的人！

source: I’m curious. What did Sir Goro’s reading say, Lloyd?
translation: 我很好奇。Lloyd，Goro先生的占卜结果是什么？

source: Well, after I drew the ‘Hanged Man’, ‘Emperor’, and ‘Death’, it sounded like Sir Goro would be undergoing some transformation!
translation: 我抽到“倒吊人”“皇帝”和“死神”后，听起来Goro先生会经历某种转变！

source: Wh-Wha? ‘Death’?! Does that mean Gramps is gonna die of something other than old age?!
translation: 什、什么？“死神”？！这是不是意味着Gramps会因为老年以外的原因死掉？！

source: Cut out the ageism, Aiden.
translation: 别再年龄歧视了，Aiden。

source: N-No! Don’t be intimidated, these cards can mean positive things like readjustment, accomplishment, and leadership!
translation: 不、不是！别被吓到了，这些牌也可以代表调整、成就和领导力等积极含义！

source: Although the hanged man usually depicts sacrifice, it can also mean wisdom, or making the right choices.
translation: 虽然倒吊人通常象征牺牲，但也可以意味着智慧，或做出正确的选择。

source: You definitely have some interesting developments in store for you, Sir Goro! And maybe some tough decisions too.
translation: Goro先生，你的未来绝对会有一些有趣的发展！也许还会面临艰难的决定。

source: Be firm with your volitions, and you’ll achieve your ideal happiness, or else it could lead to your ultimate regret!
translation: 坚定自己的意志，你就能获得理想的幸福，否则可能会走向最终的悔恨！

source: E-Even though it sounds kind of vague, it still sounds grim… Is Sir Goro going to be alright?
translation: 虽、虽然听起来有些含糊，但还是挺不祥的……Goro先生会没事吗？

source: Well, I’ll just take it all with a grain of salt.
translation: 好吧，我会姑且听之。

source: That’s a good mindset for the whole thing.
translation: 这是面对整件事的好心态。

source: I also expect you all to take my evaluations from yesterday into account.
translation: 我也希望你们把我昨天的评估考虑进去。

source: I’ll just catch up, Sir Goro.
translation: 我会跟上的，Goro先生。

source: Sir Goro already assigned me to help him out with managerial duties …
translation: Goro先生已经安排我帮他处理管理事务……

source: I think the best way for me to improve would be to work in his department!
translation: 我觉得，要提升自己，最好的办法就是在他的部门工作！

source: What…?!
With that old man?
translation: 和那个老头子？

source: So, you’re telling me you’re just going to let things run as they are, refusing any changes for the sake of the camp? My ears must be broken!
translation: 所以，你是说你打算就这样放任事情发展，为了营地拒绝任何改变？我的耳朵一定坏了！

source: And how can you grow and utilize your full potential as a future leader if you keep sitting on the sidelines?!
translation: 如果你一直坐在场边袖手旁观，未来作为领导者的你要如何成长并发挥全部潜力？！

source: The Yoshinori I know aspired for greater things, and not allowing himself to be bossed around so easily!
translation: 我认识的Yoshinori可是向往更伟大的事物，也不会这么轻易任人摆布！

source: What’s going on here? I thought the meeting was over.
translation: 这是怎么回事？我以为会议结束了。

source: Mr. Nomoru. Why did you adjust someone’s position in the camp without my knowledge?
translation: Nomoru先生。你为什么不经过我同意就调整营地里某人的职位？

source: Yoshinori was supposed to be under my wing, not yours. That’s how I wrote it in the outline I gave everyone today.
translation: Yoshinori本来应该归我指导，而不是你。今天我给大家的计划纲要里就是这么写的。

source: That decision isn’t up to only you, Ms. Komarova. You need both mine and Yoshinori’s consent as well.
translation: 这不是你一个人说了算，Komarova女士。你还需要我和Yoshinori本人的同意。

source: But I’m the manager here!
translation: 但我是这里的经理！

source: And I’m the president. My decisions are the final say for the camp. Even Mr. Clermont asks for my permission before making changes.
translation: 而我是营地负责人。我的决定对营地来说就是最终决定。甚至Clermont先生做出调整前也会征求我的许可。

source: Fine then.
translation: 那好。

source: You should know this is the last time I’ll try and advocate for you, Yoshinori. Don’t come crying to me when something goes wrong later.
translation: 你应该知道，这是我最后一次试图为你争取了，Yoshinori。以后出了什么问题，别哭着来找我。

source: Emillia—
translation: Emillia——

source: Leave her be. Things didn’t exactly go the way she wanted today.
translation: 别管她。今天的事情没有完全按她的意愿发展。

source: With this incident, she’s already earned a strike from me. If she keeps up this behavior, I might have to take further action.
translation: 这件事已经让我给她记了一次过。如果她继续这样，我可能不得不采取进一步行动。

source: Anyway, the others are waiting for us to eat. Shall we go and join them?
translation: 不管怎样，其他人还在等我们吃饭。我们过去和他们一起吃吧？

source: Oh, r-right! Yes, sir!
translation: 哦，对、对！好的，先生！

source: Oh! They’re back, you guys!
translation: 哦！他们回来了，大家！

source: Over here, Yoshi and Gramps!
translation: 这边，Yoshi和Gramps！

source: Hehe, yeah… Your food’s gotten cold already.
translation: 嘿嘿，是啊……你们的饭已经凉了。

source: We were gonna wait for you guys, but everyone’s kinda in a hurry.
translation: 我们本来打算等你们的，但大家都有点着急。

source: W-We figured we’d show up for work early now that we have an inspector…
translation: 我、我们想，既然现在有检查员，就早点来工作……

source: Why did Sir Goro follow you and Emilia? Did something happen?
translation: 为什么Goro先生跟着你和Emilia？发生什么事了吗？

source: Hmph. Dad probably just stopped her from shit-talking all of us.
translation: 哼。爸爸肯定只是阻止她说我们所有人的坏话。

source: No… I already promised I’d help Sir Goro with his admin tasks, so, I turned her down…
translation: 不……我已经答应帮Goro先生做行政工作，所以拒绝了她……

source: Not well, honestly… She got pretty angry.
translation: 说实话，不太好……她非常生气。

source: Yikes… I can only imagine…
translation: 糟糕……我完全可以想象……

source: But luckily Sir Goro showed up and took control of the situation.
translation: 但幸好Goro先生出现并控制了局面。

source: As soon as I arrived, I could tell she was trying to corner you.
translation: 我一到就看出来了，她正试图把你逼到角落。

source: She doesn’t seem to take rejection well… Just like when I spoke up at the meeting earlier.
translation: 她似乎不太能接受被拒绝……就像我之前在会议上发言时一样。

source: Exactly. We don’t need to like her, but Mr. Clermont assigned her here for a reason. We have to trust his judgement.
translation: 正是如此。我们不必喜欢她，但Clermont先生把她安排到这里是有原因的。我们必须相信他的判断。

source: And don’t worry, all of you. If Emilia insists on handling things immaturely, I won’t hesitate to reprimand her.
translation: 还有，大家别担心。如果Emilia坚持用不成熟的方式处理事情，我不会犹豫训斥她。

source: Yeah, tell her, Gramps!
translation: 对，就该这么告诉她，Gramps！

source: On that note… I-I think I have to get to work before Emilia thinks I’m slacking…
translation: 说到这个……我、我得先去工作了，免得Emilia以为我在偷懒……

source: Please excuse me…
translation: 请允许我先离开……

source: Yikes, I just remembered I have to get the workers’ rooms cleaned up!
translation: 糟糕，我刚想起来还得把工人们的房间收拾干净！

source: Gotta go!
translation: 我得走了！

source: Thanks for reassuring everyone after this morning, Dad!
translation: 谢谢你在今天早上之后安慰大家，爸爸！

source: I’m off to check on the workers – see you boys later!
translation: 我去看看工人们——晚点见，各位！

source: I guess that’s our cue to get started as well, Yoshinori.
translation: 我想这就是我们也该开始工作的信号了，Yoshinori。

source: Ah, sorry. I was just thinking about how Emilia reacted back there.
translation: 啊，抱歉。我只是在想Emilia刚才的反应。

source: What exactly are you worried about?
translation: 你到底在担心什么？

source: What exactly are you worried about?{fast}
translation: 你到底在担心什么？{fast}

source: I don't want you to get stressed.
translation: 我不想让你感到压力。

source: I don’t want you to get stressed because of Emilia.
translation: 我不想让你因为Emilia而感到压力。

source: I won’t. And It doesn’t matter as long as we do our jobs.
translation: 不会的。只要我们做好自己的工作，其他都不重要。

source: Emilia might be more trouble than help.
translation: Emilia可能会带来更多麻烦，而不是帮助。

source: I’m afraid Emilia might cause us more trouble than help.
translation: 我担心Emilia可能给我们带来的麻烦会多于帮助。

source: Not on my watch.
translation: 有我在，不会的。

source: I want us to enjoy this project.
translation: 我希望我们能享受这个项目。

source: Well… I want us to enjoy this project, sir.
translation: 嗯……我希望我们能享受这个项目，先生。

source: Hmm? What makes you think otherwise?
translation: 嗯？你为什么会这么想？

source: I feel like Emilia’s not going to make it easy for us for some reason…
translation: 不知道为什么，我总觉得Emilia不会让我们轻松……

source: I really hope I can help.
translation: 我真的希望自己能帮上忙。

source: Well… I just really hope I can help you with this project, sir.
translation: 嗯……我只是非常希望能帮你完成这个项目，先生。

source: Like I said to everyone earlier, you can count on me to put Emilia in her place if she gets out of bounds.
translation: 就像我之前对大家说的，如果Emilia越界，你可以指望我让她安分下来。

source: I have no doubts about that, sir… But I had just hoped that going into this season, you wouldn’t have to deal with something like this.
translation: 我对此毫不怀疑，先生……但我只是希望进入这个季度后，你不用面对这样的事情。

source: I appreciate your honesty, Yoshinori. And I know exactly what you mean when you say that.
translation: 我很欣赏你的坦诚，Yoshinori。我完全明白你这么说是什么意思。

source: However, I need you to understand that I’m trying to change too. Or at least to be back to how I was long ago.
translation: 不过，我需要你明白，我也在努力改变。或者至少，努力回到很久以前的那个我。

source: As Camp Buddy’s leader, I should be able to do my job with patience and kindness. Not with strictness and heartless professionalism.
translation: 作为 Camp Buddy 的领导者，我应该耐心而友善地完成自己的工作，而不是严苛地、冷酷地以专业主义行事。

source: I want everyone, especially you, to be able to trust and count on me again, just like you did back then.
translation: 我希望所有人，尤其是你，都能像过去那样再次信任我、依靠我。

source: Sir Goro…
translation: Goro先生……

source: So, don’t worry, and just focus on the great work we’ll be doing together for Camp Buddy. It’ll be just like the good ol’ days!
translation: 所以别担心，只管专注于我们要为 Camp Buddy 一起完成的伟大工作吧。会像过去的美好时光一样！

source: Just follow my lead, and everything will be fine!
translation: 只要跟着我的步调，一切都会好起来！

source: For the next few weeks, Sir Goro and I worked side by side on our tasks.
translation: 接下来的几周里，Goro先生和我并肩处理各项事务。

source: I was pretty shocked at how different and mentally taxing management could be.
translation: 我很震惊，管理工作竟然如此不同，而且如此消耗精神。

source: But thankfully, Sir Goro didn’t lose patience and guided me every step of the way until I was able to adjust.
translation: 但幸好Goro先生没有失去耐心，一步步指导我，直到我适应为止。

source: Occasionally, Sir Goro and I would help Lloyd and Darius with their department to accelerate the progress, not hesitating to get our hands dirty.
translation: 偶尔，为了加快进度，Goro先生和我会去帮Lloyd和Darius处理他们部门的工作，毫不介意亲自动手。

source: In the evenings, we’d work with Jin towards the technological goals of the project. Sometimes even joining him in his sleepless nights.
translation: 晚上，我们和Jin一起朝着项目的技术目标努力。有时甚至陪他度过不眠之夜。

source: We had to relaunch our website and keep it updated to cater for online enrollments and job applications.
translation: 我们必须重新上线网站并持续更新，以便处理在线报名和求职申请。

source: From what Jin explained, he also managed to secure an internet connection and a security system for the camp.
translation: 按照Jin的说法，他还设法为营地接入了互联网，并安装了安保系统。

source: Meanwhile, Aiden was swamped with chores, as usual.
translation: 与此同时，Aiden一如既往地被家务压得喘不过气。

source: Between cooking, laundry, repairs, and cleaning for a horde of workers, there was more to do than ever before.
translation: 做饭、洗衣、维修，还要为一大群工人打扫卫生，要做的事情比以前更多。

source: Thankfully, because Sir Goro and I were handling most of the management, Yuri was able to focus on assisting Aiden.
translation: 幸好，因为Goro先生和我承担了大部分管理工作，Yuri得以专心协助Aiden。

source: I’m not exactly sure how helpful she’s been, knowing how distracted she could get when she’s around Aiden.
translation: 考虑到她在Aiden身边时很容易分心，我也不太确定她到底帮了多少忙。

source: Although, I’m pretty guilty of being distracted sometimes too.
translation: 不过，我有时也很容易分心。

source: Ever since Sir Goro moved into our cabin, I started to see his more casual and playful side, which took some getting used to considering he’s my boss.
translation: 自从Goro先生搬进我们的木屋，我开始看到他更随和、更爱玩的一面；考虑到他是我的老板，这也需要一段时间适应。

source: On top of our other responsibilities, Sir Goro had me tag along to his meetings and appointments. With each one, I started to gain confidence and learn from him.
translation: 除了其他职责，Goro先生还让我陪他参加会议和约见。每参加一次，我就更有信心，也从他身上学到更多。

source: It made me realize how easy it is to take for granted how much serious, but not always exciting, work Sir Goro does behind the scenes outside of the camp…
translation: 这让我意识到，在营地之外，Goro先生在幕后所做的工作有多么严肃——虽然不总是令人兴奋，却很容易被人视为理所当然……

source: He never once complains about it though, and always get everything done without concern.
translation: 但他从不抱怨，总是毫不在意地把所有事情完成。

source: As we had expected, there were times when Emilia would criticize the way Sir Goro had been running things, making her grow more and more frustrated.
translation: 正如我们所预料的，有时Emilia会批评Goro先生的管理方式，让她越来越烦躁。

source: I could see how Sir Goro was trying his best to control himself and stay focused on the task. The least I could do was always keep him company.
translation: 我能看出Goro先生正努力控制自己，专注于工作。至少我能做的，就是始终陪着他。

source: But even though our work could get overwhelming, he would always make sure we enjoyed the few peaceful moments we got to spend with just the two of us. It’s what encouraged me to keep doing my best.
translation: 尽管工作可能让人不堪重负，他总会确保我们享受仅属于我们两人的短暂平静时光。这鼓励我继续尽力。

source: Feeling closer to Sir Goro made it all worth it.
translation: 感觉和Goro先生更亲近，让这一切都值得。

source: {i}Before we knew it, a month and a half had gone by and the season was about to change again…{/i}
translation: {i}不知不觉，一个半月过去了，季节又即将变化……{/i}
